items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: New Orleans was founded in 1718 by a French-Canadian, Jean Baptiste, Le Moyne-Circ de Benville.

ctx.x: Truly, the old order changes, yielding to the new. So that look where you may in this country, you shall scarcely be able to find a more striking example of this adage than the city of New Orleans affords at its present stage. Here progress is making breaches in the old order, letting in the new. Not since the boom of the thirties, when the city bid fare to rival, if not outshine New York. Has it been seen so much transition? Not in 50 years has there been such a reopening of home pride, civic spirit, and…
Why don't you try to read one of your poems if you'd like and run over it once and then we'll do it with a machine on it. 19, 37.
